profile_name: Scoring horizon ON (measured at -4.29 VP — rejected)
description: Enables the scoring-horizon model: an objective's value scales with the scoring opportunities remaining after arrival and collapses past the horizon. Measured against the shipped default over 12 paired side-swapped seeds on mirror_custodes_postdeploy at E = -4.29 VP/game, 95% CI [-7.43, -1.15] — clearly worse, so it ships disabled. Kept so the result can be reproduced and so variants (a gentler MOVE_UNREACHABLE_FLOOR) can be tested against the same baseline.
